results.title: Trump approval falls to new low as voters say U.S. is 'out of control"

results.content:
The latest figures mark a modest improvement from early July, when 52% of Alabama voters approved of Trump’s job performance, 41% disapproved and 7% were unsure or held no opinion.

However, Trump’s standing remains below where it was at the beginning of his second term.

At his Jan. 20 inauguration, 59% of Alabama voters approved of his job performance, compared with 37% who disapproved and 4% who were unsure.
